subject: The control bar's Playhead Position group, across display modes
question: A reading three hours earlier found the transport answering bar.beat and called a region start tick unreadable, while naming the display mode as an open route. Does a mode exist that shows ticks, and can the product select it without coordinates?

reverify.command: Manual. Find the control bar's AXPopUpButton whose AXDescription matches `AXLocalePolicy.displayModePopupLabel`, open it with AXShowMenu, and press the item whose AXTitle matches `beatsDisplayModeItem` — by title, never by position. Then read the AXGroup matching `playheadPositionGroupLabel` and list its slider children. Restore the mode you found.
reverify.expected: In `비트 및 프로젝트` / Beats & Project the group holds TWO named sliders, bar and beat, and `logic_transport.goto_position` with a four-component request answers State B readback_unavailable observing two components. In `비트` / Beats the same group holds FOUR — bar, beat, division, tick — and the same request answers State A observing four.

method: A probe read every descendant of the control bar, then the named Playhead Position group and the display-mode popup's menu items. The mode was switched by matching the item's AXTitle, never by index or coordinate, and switched back at the end. `goto_position` was driven through the release binary in BOTH modes, before and after changing the reader, so the four readings separate what Logic does from what the product does.

observations.mode: 비트 및 프로젝트 (Beats & Project, the mode found)

observations.what: the same mode after the reader was taught the other two labels
restoring the mode that was found
display-mode menu items, read by title

conclusion: How many position components the transport exposes is a property of the control bar's DISPLAY MODE, not of Logic. In `비트` / Beats the Playhead Position group holds four named sliders — bar, beat, division, tick — and the mode is selectable by menu-item title, with no coordinate anywhere. The product was reading two of the four and discarding the rest, so a four-component request could not verify even while the display was showing all four; taught the other two labels, `goto_position` answers State A observing four, and restoring the original mode returns it to two and State B. Sub-bar transport positions are therefore verifiable, and the tick resolution that `2026-09-14-the-seam-is-not-the-blocker-a-region-start-tick-is-not-readable` could not find on this surface is here after all.
limits: Korean only. The division and tick label sets carry `디비전` and `틱` as measured variants and English canonicals that were NOT read off an English Logic; ja-JP and de-DE have no variant at all, so this reader gains nothing on those hosts until someone measures them.

This measures the PLAYHEAD position. Whether a REGION's start can be read at tick resolution is still open: it would need the playhead moved to the region start and that move verified, which was not done here. So the blocker under ADR-010 / ADR-014 R2 / ADR-015 is narrowed, not closed.

The product does not SELECT the display mode. Everything above was measured with the mode switched by a probe; the shipped reader reports whatever the mode happens to expose and says so in observed_position_components. Making the product choose the mode is a separate change with its own restore obligation.
One host, one build, one project. `사용자 설정` / Custom was not opened, so whether a custom format can expose something finer or differently named is unmeasured.
The four-segment reading was taken with the playhead parked by goto_position itself. It was not checked against a playhead moved by Logic's own transport during playback.
